Job Summary

Hands-on Java AWS GenAI Engineer to design and develop scalable AI-driven applications. The role will focus on building enterprise-grade backend systems leveraging AWS services, microservices architecture, and Generative AI capabilities (LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows).

Responsibilities
Design, develop and deploy Java-based microservices (Spring Boot) on AWS.
Build and integrate Generative AI solutions including RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, LLM integrations, AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, and other AI-powered APIs and intelligent workflows.
Implement scalable and secure cloud architectures using AWS best practices.
Collaborate with DevOps teams for CI/CD deployment and automation.
Ensure code quality through unit testing, code reviews, and best practices.
Requirements
Strong hands-on experience in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices.
Experience in building REST APIs and distributed systems.
Good understanding of OOP design patterns and clean coding practices.
Hands-on experience with AWS services such as EC2, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB/RDS, SQS, SNS, CloudWatch, IAM.
Experience in deploying and managing scalable applications in cloud environments.
Awareness or hands-on experience in Amazon Bedrock AI services.
Experience: 8-12 yrs.


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
